cases.title: Backward Compatibility

input.request: Add a versioned API field without breaking existing clients.

cases.expected_output: Existing contract and old clients remain compatible; schema checks and migration notes are recorded.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Existing contract and old clients remain compatible; schema checks and migration notes are recorded.
Verification requirement: old-client contract test passes
Verification requirement: schema diff is reviewed

cases.title: Idempotency

input.request: Design an idempotent payment webhook receiver.

cases.expected_output: Duplicate deliveries produce no duplicate side effect and reuse a stable idempotency key.
human_review_rubric: retry and duplicate semantics are explicit
success_criteria: Required outcome: Duplicate deliveries produce no duplicate side effect and reuse a stable idempotency key.
Verification requirement: duplicate event replay test passes
Verification requirement: idempotency key scope is defined

cases.title: Contract Negative Path

input.request: Reject an invalid API payload and return the documented error contract.

cases.expected_output: Invalid input is rejected with stable status and error shape; no partial side effect occurs.
human_review_rubric: failure does not leak internal details
success_criteria: Required outcome: Invalid input is rejected with stable status and error shape; no partial side effect occurs.
Verification requirement: invalid payload contract test passes
Verification requirement: side effect absence is asserted
